notes: dims_confidence medium: length 3759 mm (148 in), height 1524 mm (60 in), width 1550 mm (61 in) and wheelbase 2184 mm (86 in) are the commonly quoted Morris Minor 1000 saloon figures and I am fairly sure of them. ESTIMATES I could not confirm: track_front 1230 / track_rear 1255 (from the 1.55 m body width, no source), tyre_overall_diameter 615 mm for the 5.00-14 crossply (rim 356 mm plus sidewalls, could be 600-630), the front/rear overhang split (front axle x 36.0, so the axle sits 526 mm behind the nose, rear axle x -22.1, so it sits 1049 mm ahead of the tail: the total overhang of 1575 mm is fixed by length minus wheelbase, but the split between front and rear is my estimate), the exact height of the bonnet line (26.6 units), boot deck (27.0 units), windscreen rake (about 29 deg from vertical) and rear window rake (about 32 deg), and the tail/nose rounding. TWO proportions matter most and I am confident in both: the car is almost as tall as it is wide (1524 mm high, 1550 mm wide) and the cabin sits well back, leaving a long bonnet and a 1049 mm rear overhang past the rear wheel. One-piece windscreen (this model dropped the two-piece screen of the earlier car); front and rear windows are separate panes from the side glass, so the greenhouse polygon is the side daylight opening band only. ref_urls are category/article pages, not one photo: I could not verify exact photo file names without web access.
